meta.name: river-flooding-siege-tactic
meta.description: Use when besieging a fortified city resistant to conventional assault. Plans river diversion to compromise walls through hydraulic pressure. Based on Wang Ben's 225 BCE flooding of Daliang that forced Wei's surrender.

copy.tagline: 模拟古代水攻战术，规划河流改道淹没城墙
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果对古代攻城战术或历史战役模拟感兴趣
copy.tagline_en: Simulate ancient water siege tactics by planning river diversion to flood walls
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are interested in ancient siege tactics or historical battle simulation

howto.what: 当你请求攻打一座防御坚固、常规手段难以攻破的城市时，它会规划引水淹城的工程方案：勘察地形、开凿沟渠、引水冲垮城墙，并指导后续受降与领土控制。
howto.when: 当你要围攻一座常规攻击无效的堡垒，且周围有可利用的水源时，它会自动进入水攻规划模式。

say.text: 我们被这座坚城挡住了，试试水攻吧。
say.note: Claude会开始勘察周边河流并规划引水路线。

say.text: 模拟王贲水淹大梁的过程。
say.note: Claude会参照225 BCE案例制定具体步骤。

say.text: 计算引水对城墙的压力。
say.note: Claude会评估水流速度和结构破坏时间。

howto.what_en: When you request to besiege a heavily fortified city that resists conventional assault, it plans a hydraulic warfare procedure: survey terrain, dig diversion channels, flood to collapse walls, then accept surrender and secure territory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe a siege against a fortress that resists normal attacks and has accessible water sources for diversion.

say_en.text: We're stuck at this stronghold, let's try flooding.
say_en.note: Claude will survey nearby rivers and plan diversion routes.

say_en.text: Simulate Wang Ben's flooding of Daliang.
say_en.note: Claude will reference the 225 BCE historical case.

say_en.text: Calculate water pressure on the walls.
say_en.note: Claude will assess flow rate and structural failure time.
